entities.name: Unknown maternal HBsAg newborn prophylaxis
observations: For a newborn weighing at least 2,000 g when maternal HBsAg status is unknown, administer single-antigen hepatitis B vaccine within 12 hours of birth; urgently determine maternal status and give HBIG if she tests positive, as soon as possible and no later than age 7 days.

entities.name: PMID:25442652
observations: Retrospective comparative study of 100 hip arthroscopy procedures: HO occurred in 14/50 capsule-closure cases; overall HO was 36%; closure versus non-closure did not differ significantly (P=.144), nor did clinically significant HO (Brooker >I; P=.764).

entities.name: PMID:31570008
observations: Systematic review/meta-analysis of 12 comparative studies (1,185 hips); reported no significant difference in HO rates between repaired and unrepaired capsulotomy groups.
Evidence was insufficient to establish superiority of capsule repair.

entities.name: PMID:30104930
observations: Systematic review of comparative studies concluded that capsular closure does not influence postoperative HO rates; overall evidence for routine closure was inconclusive.

entities.name: PMID:35482060
observations: Scoping review of 45 studies: weak evidence suggested no capsular closure may be associated with higher HO risk; five of six studies evaluating NSAID prophylaxis found lower HO incidence with NSAID use.

entities.name: Capsule closure and HO
observations: A 100-procedure retrospective comparison and two systematic reviews found no statistically significant difference in postoperative HO incidence by capsular closure status; certainty is limited by observational evidence.
